weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，你可能會發現自己與各種合作夥伴進行了熱烈的討論，無論是在商業、健身還是浪漫方面。期待收到有趣的見解，激發您的好奇心，並值得進行更深入的調查。這是敲定法律文件或作出任何重大承諾的絕佳日子。考慮報名參加線上課程或工作坊，以擴展你的知識。善用當天的正能量！
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, you may find yourself engaged in lively discussions with various partners, whether in business, fitness, or romance. Expect to receive intriguing insights that pique your curiosity and warrant deeper investigation. It's an excellent day for finalizing legal documents or making any significant commitments. Consider enrolling in an online course or workshop to expand your knowledge. Harness the positive energies of the day to your advantage!

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天充滿了令人振奮的對話。您的精力水平將會飆升，因此是深入完成任務的最佳時機，特別是如果這些任務涉及文書工作的話。考慮擠壓鍛煉、探索您的寫作技巧，或深入研究有關健康和保健的最新發現。書籍、雜誌和線上文章等資源尤其有益。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today promises to be filled with invigorating conversations, Taurus. Your energy levels are set to soar, making it a perfect time to dive into your tasks, especially if they involve paperwork. Consider squeezing in a workout, exploring your writing skills, or delving into the latest findings on health and wellness. Resources like books, magazines, and online articles will be particularly beneficial.
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 今天，雙子座，你可能會受到啟發，將筆寫在紙上。雖然這可能與工作有關，但無論是與朋友和同事建立聯繫，還是探索自己的創意方面，這都更可能是屬於個人性質。與朋友、浪漫伴侶或兒童進行對話，可能會在腦海中引發一連串新鮮的想法。此外，這是參與單人運動或活動的絕佳日子。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you may feel inspired to put pen to paper. While this could pertain to work, it’s more likely to be of a personal nature, whether it’s connecting with friends and colleagues or exploring your creative side. Engaging conversations with friends, romantic partners, or children could spark a flurry of fresh ideas in your mind. Additionally, it’s an excellent day to engage in a solo sport or activity.

cancer.horoscope: 今天，你可能會接到志同道合的人的電話，分享你的熱情。不妨考慮在聊天時散步，因為這可能會引發一些熱烈的討論。為對話中的一些重疊做好準備，因為你們兩個可能會同時說話而感到興奮！你也可能會發現有趣的新書，激起你的興趣。晚上稍後，您可以觀看與您所探索主題相關的串流電影，放鬆身心。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, you may receive calls from like-minded individuals who share your passions. Consider taking a stroll while chatting, as this could lead to some lively discussions. Be prepared for a bit of overlap in conversation, as excitement may have you both speaking at once! You might also discover intriguing new books that pique your interest. Later in the evening, unwind by streaming films related to the topics you've explored.

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，今天你的智力很敏銳，精力充沛，是潛入刺激思維的活動（如閱讀、寫作或分享知識）的最佳時機。參與對話將特別有益，因此請花一些時間在電話上聊天。記得記下來的有趣想法，因為你會發現它們很吸引人，值得記住。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, your intellect is sharp and buzzing with energy, making it a perfect time to dive into activities that stimulate your mind, such as reading, writing, or sharing knowledge. Engaging in conversations will be particularly rewarding, so expect to spend some time chatting on the phone. Be sure to jot down the intriguing ideas that come your way, as you'll find them captivating and worth remembering.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天可能是你深入研究財務文件並旨在結束一切的日子。這是完成這項任務的絕佳時機，儘管您可能會發現自己將標準設得有點高，並且沒有像您希望的那樣完成。現在就運用你的寫作技巧，因為靈感可以自由流動。為一連串的訊息或電話做好準備，讓這一天充滿活力。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today could be the day you dive into your financial documents and aim to wrap everything up, Virgo. It's an excellent time for this task, though you may find yourself setting the bar a bit high and not accomplishing as much as you hoped. Harness your writing skills now, as inspiration may flow freely. Be prepared for a flurry of messages or calls, making this a lively and engaging day.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，你的智力通常很敏銳，渴望知識，但今天它可能更加明顯。你對探索的渴望加劇，你可能會發現自己正在探索非傳統的途徑來解決它。此外，您可能會感受到一股能量激增，激勵您進行劇烈的鍛煉。擁抱這種衝動！體育活動可以幫助你清理思緒，並為你提供有關所遇到的新想法和資訊的新見解。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, your intellect is typically sharp and eager for knowledge, but today it’s likely to be even more pronounced. Your thirst for discovery is heightened, and you may find yourself exploring unconventional avenues to quench it. Additionally, you might feel a surge of energy that inspires you to engage in a vigorous workout. Embrace this urge! Physical activity can help clear your mind and provide you with fresh insights into the new ideas and information you encounter.

scorpio.horoscope: 作為天蠍座，你今天的自然敏感度和直覺得到了增強。深入了解來自不同時代和文化的人的生活和經歷，可以加深您對他們的情緒和思想的理解，為您提供對人性的新視角。這種提高的意識將大大加強您的創意努力，特別是在寫作方面。請務必記下您收到的任何想法，以便捕捉這些寶貴的見解。
scorpio.horoscope_en: As a Scorpio, your natural sensitivity and intuition are heightened today. Delving into the lives and experiences of people from different eras and cultures could deepen your understanding of their emotions and thoughts, offering you fresh perspectives on human nature. This heightened awareness will greatly enhance your creative endeavors, especially in writing. Be sure to jot down any ideas that come to you, so you can capture these valuable insights.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你可能會發現自己在一個團體環境或社交聚會中，引發了一連串有趣的想法，可能會讓你感到不知所措。您可以與分享您的熱情並希望深入探索這些討論的新朋友建立聯繫。您的精神敏捷性今天得到了提高，讓您能夠掌握通常不會引起您注意的非傳統概念。 但是，請謹慎行事，因為您的思維可能會急轉彎；請留意周圍環境，以避免發生任何意外。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you might find yourself in a group setting or social gathering that sparks a flurry of intriguing ideas, potentially overwhelming you with their abundance. You may connect with new friends who share your passions and wish to delve deeper into these discussions. Your mental agility is heightened today, allowing you to grasp unconventional concepts that typically wouldn't catch your attention. However, be cautious as your mind may be racing; stay aware of your surroundings to avoid any mishaps.

capricorn.horoscope: 今天，摩羯座，你可能會發現自己被埋在需要你注意的文件中。引導您的專注力和精力，有效率地處理這些任務。與同事進行討論可以幫助您保持專注，避免任何單調的感覺。隨著一天的結束，不妨考慮散步，幫助處理你收集的所有新資訊，讓你能夠刷新思維，充分吸收一切。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you may find yourself buried in paperwork that demands your attention. Channel your focus and energy into tackling these tasks efficiently. Engaging discussions with coworkers can help keep your mind engaged and stave off any feelings of monotony. As the day wraps up, consider taking a stroll to help process all the new information you've gathered, allowing you to refresh your mind and fully absorb everything.

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你可能會發現自己被吸引去開闊視野。如果情況允許，也許你可以考慮前往你一直夢寐以求的目的地。或者，您可以考慮繼續深造以獲得高級資格。無論您選擇哪條路，都希望將一天中的大部分時間用於探索這些可能性和收集資訊。 別忘了抽出一些時間進行鍛煉，以幫助釋放當天累積的緊張情緒。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you may find yourself drawn to broaden your horizons. Perhaps you'll contemplate a journey to a destination you've long dreamed of exploring, if circumstances allow. Alternatively, you might think about pursuing further education for an advanced qualification. Regardless of the path you choose, expect to dedicate a good portion of your day to exploring these possibilities and gathering information. Don't forget to carve out some time for a workout to help release any built-up tension from the day.

pisces.horoscope: 作為雙魚座，您的好奇心通常會引導您探索人類心靈、宇宙和精神信仰的複雜性。今天，你可能會發現你在閱讀或對話中遇到的東西點燃了你的魅力。這可能是一個完美的機會，讓你沉浸在一個吸引你的主題中，並盡可能多地吸收知識。請記住，您的見解與其他人的見解一樣有價值，因此請務必將其記下來！
pisces.horoscope_en: As a Pisces, your curiosity often leads you to explore the intricacies of the human psyche, the cosmos, and spiritual beliefs. Today, you may find your fascination ignited by something you come across in reading or conversation. This could be the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in a subject that captivates you and absorb as much knowledge as possible. Remember, your insights are just as valuable as anyone else's, so be sure to jot them down!
